exceptions.purpose: RDOC_TRIGGER_FRAMES headless frame-number capture trigger, so unmodified third-party applications can be captured without a GUI. Upstream RenderDoc has no equivalent env control.

granted_by.note: That step granted this declared working-tree modification and simultaneously forbade every other tracked file.

provenance.scope_note: Narrowed from *.json after the F3 check rejected it: N3-02 and N3-03 were captured without the patch and record no mechanism, so only the N3-05A captures are covered by this exception.

exceptions.scope_note: This exception authorises exactly the modification described above and nothing else. It does not carry forward to any future patch: a new patch must re-enter the same Contract and evidence flow and be declared separately.
